title: Integration Architecture Principles Catalogue
description: Catalogue of architecture principles for the Integration architecture domain — vendor-neutral guidelines that shape design decisions. Aligned to TOGAF Architecture Principles (Name, Statement, Rationale, Implications).

meta.description: The guiding principles that shape how Integration architecture decisions are made.
purpose: Establishes consistent patterns for how systems exchange data and events
Reduces integration complexity by making the preferred approach explicit
Provides decision criteria for API, event, and messaging design choices
Enables automated analysis of proposed integrations against established patterns
Supports technology-independent reasoning about system connectivity

$schema.description: URN of the schema this instance conforms to (this file's $id).

statement.description: The principle, stated as a directive

rationale.description: Why this principle exists — the underlying motivation

implications.description: Consequences for design and decision-making if this principle is adopted
